PROJECTS (Mehwish's Projects)
Micropropagation of wheat calluses
Induced embryogenic callus formation from wheat explants under sterile conditions. Maintained and sub cultured callus cultures for plant tissue propagation. Performed Agrobacterium tumefaciens mediated transformation techniques.
E. coli Competent Cell Preparation & Transformation
Prepared chemically competent Escherichia coli cells. Performed plasmid transformation using an available DNA construct. Evaluated transformation success using standard microbiological techniques.
Quantification of Protein in Local Duckweed
Estimated total protein content of local duckweed samples using the Bradford assay. Prepared standards and measured absorbance with spectrophotometric analysis. Interpreted experimental data for comparative protein quantification.
Microscopic Identification of Plant Species
Identified 35 plant species using microscopic examination of leaf anatomy. Distinguished species based on midrib and vascular bundle arrangements. Recorded and documented anatomical characteristics for taxonomic identification.
